title: Thought catcher
desc: When you drift into distractions for a while, offers to note down what's on your mind

variables.name: stretch_asked
variables.desc: whether this distraction stretch was asked on

signals.name: distracted
signals.desc: in distractions for 5 minutes, a minute's break at most

signals.name: near_distraction
signals.desc: a distraction in the last minute

next.desc: a distraction stretch, not asked on yet

stretch_over.desc: the next stretch may be asked on

ask_usr.context: Something on your mind? Jot it down here and it'll keep, so you can let it go.
ask_usr.title: On your mind?

do.name: nudged
do.desc: quiet for a while now, longer if it went unanswered

set.name: nudged_at
set.expr: time + (nudge_gap if said is None else 0)
